description: Check an SPF record (RFC 7208) and/or a DMARC record (RFC 9989, which replaced RFC 7489) pasted as text, e.g. from `dig TXT example.com` and `dig TXT _dmarc.example.com`. Explains every SPF term and DMARC tag, counts the SPF terms that need a DNS lookup (limit 10; includes add their own, which this offline check does not follow), and flags issues with a severity: +all or ?all, no all mechanism, unknown mechanisms, bad ip4/ip6 ranges, ptr, terms after all, p=none, pct below 100, sp=none, a missing rua, invalid tag values, and (when domain is given) report addresses on another domain that need an authorization record. Makes no DNS queries.

dmarc.description: The DMARC TXT record from _dmarc.<domain>, starting with v=DMARC1

domain.description: The domain the records belong to; used to flag external report addresses

spf.description: The SPF TXT record, starting with v=spf1 (quoted split strings are joined)

name: check_spf_dmarc
